name: ospex-sdk-monorepo
description: Ospex SDK and CLI — workspace root

scripts.build: yarn workspace @ospex/sdk build && yarn workspace @ospex/cli build && yarn workspace @ospex/rules build
scripts.test: yarn workspace @ospex/sdk test && yarn workspace @ospex/cli test && yarn workspace @ospex/rules test
scripts.typecheck: yarn workspace @ospex/sdk typecheck && yarn workspace @ospex/cli typecheck && yarn workspace @ospex/rules typecheck
scripts.typecheck:tests: yarn workspace @ospex/sdk typecheck:tests && yarn workspace @ospex/cli typecheck:tests && yarn workspace @ospex/rules typecheck:tests
scripts.clean: yarn workspace @ospex/sdk clean && yarn workspace @ospex/cli clean && yarn workspace @ospex/rules clean
